ko.title: 11년 만의 백악관 방문: 시진핑 주석의 워싱턴 고위급 회담 내막

segments.src: ## A Rare Trip to Washington
segments.tr: ## 드문 워싱턴 방문

segments.src: Chinese President Xi Jinping is scheduled to arrive at the White House on September 24, marking his first visit to Washington in more than a decade.
segments.tr: 시진핑 중국 국가주석이 9월 24일 백악관에 도착할 예정이며, 이는 10여 년 만의 첫 워싱턴 방문이다.

segments.src: The trip, long anticipated by diplomats and trade analysts on both sides of the Pacific, comes at a moment when the world's two largest economies are trying to steady a relationship that has swung between cautious cooperation and open confrontation over tariffs, technology restrictions, and regional security.
segments.tr: 태평양 양안의 외교관과 무역 분석가들이 오랫동안 기다려온 이번 방문은 세계 양대 경제 대국이 관세, 기술 제한, 지역 안보를 둘러싸고 신중한 협력과 공개적인 대립 사이를 오가던 관계를 안정시키려 노력하는 시점에 이루어진다.

segments.src: For a leader who has traveled extensively across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe during his time in office, the gap in visits to the U.S.
segments.tr: 재임 기간 동안 아시아, 중동, 유럽을 광범위하게 순방한 지도자에게 있어 미국

segments.src: capital is notable.
segments.tr: 수도 방문의 공백은 눈에 띈다.

segments.src: The last time Xi set foot in the White House was under a previous American administration, long before the trade wars, export controls, and pandemic-era disruptions reshaped the contours of the U.S.-China relationship.
segments.tr: 시 주석이 마지막으로 백악관을 방문한 것은 이전 미국 행정부 시절로, 무역 전쟁, 수출 통제, 팬데믹 시대의 혼란이 미중 관계의 윤곽을 재편하기 훨씬 전이었다.

segments.src: That history alone has turned this single visit into a closely watched barometer of where the two powers stand today.
segments.tr: 그 역사만으로도 이번 단 한 번의 방문은 양국이 오늘날 어떤 위치에 있는지 보여주는 면밀히 관찰되는 척도가 되었다.

segments.src: ## A Delegation Built for Business
segments.tr: ## 비즈니스를 위해 구성된 대표단

segments.src: Xi is expected to be accompanied by a large delegation that reportedly includes senior officials alongside executives from major Chinese corporations spanning manufacturing, technology, and energy sectors.
segments.tr: 시 주석은 제조, 기술, 에너지 분야를 아우르는 중국 주요 기업의 경영진과 고위 관리들이 포함된 대규모 대표단을 대동할 것으로 예상된다.

segments.src: The scale of the business contingent suggests Beijing wants the visit to be remembered not just for diplomatic photo opportunities, but for tangible commercial outcomes — potential agreements on trade volumes, investment commitments, or easing of restrictions that have squeezed companies on both sides.
segments.tr: 비즈니스 사절단의 규모는 베이징이 이번 방문을 단순한 외교적 사진 촬영 기회가 아니라 무역 규모, 투자 약속, 또는 양측 기업을 압박해 온 제한 조치 완화와 같은 실질적인 상업적 성과로 기억되기를 원한다는 것을 시사한다.

segments.src: Analysts following the run-up to the summit say the presence of so many corporate leaders signals that economic stabilization, rather than any single breakthrough, is likely to be the practical goal.
segments.tr: 정상회담을 앞둔 상황을 지켜보는 분석가들은 수많은 기업 지도자들의 참석이 단일한 돌파구보다는 경제 안정화가 실질적인 목표일 가능성이 높다는 신호라고 말한다.

segments.src: Years of tariff escalation, supply-chain rerouting, and tit-for-tat export controls on items like semiconductors and rare earth materials have left businesses on both sides eager for predictability, even if a full resolution of underlying disputes remains distant.
segments.tr: 수년간의 관세 인상, 공급망 재편, 반도체 및 희토류와 같은 품목에 대한 상호 보복성 수출 통제는 근본적인 분쟁에 대한 완전한 해결책이 요원하더라도 양측 기업들이 예측 가능성을 갈망하게 만들었다.

segments.src: ## Taiwan Arms Sales: The Summit's Fault Line
segments.tr: ## 대만 무기 판매: 정상회담의 갈등 요인

segments.src: Even as preparations move forward, the visit is shadowed by a familiar irritant in U.S.-China relations: arms sales to Taiwan.
segments.tr: 준비가 진행되고 있음에도 불구하고, 이번 방문은 미중 관계의 익숙한 골칫거리인 대만에 대한 무기 판매라는 그림자가 드리워져 있다.

segments.src: Beijing has issued pointed warnings that any new American weapons package for Taipei announced around the time of the visit could jeopardize the summit's tone, if not its substance.
segments.tr: 베이징은 방문 시기에 맞춰 발표될 수 있는 미국의 새로운 대만 무기 패키지가 정상회담의 실질적인 내용은 차치하고라도 그 분위기를 위태롭게 할 수 있다고 날카로운 경고를 보냈다.

segments.src: Chinese officials have long treated U.S.
segments.tr: 중국 관리들은 오랫동안 미국의

segments.src: arms sales to the self-governed island as a direct challenge to what they consider a core sovereignty issue, and past sales have reliably triggered diplomatic protests, military posturing near the Taiwan Strait, and temporary freezes in bilateral communication.
segments.tr: 자치 정부가 운영하는 섬에 대한 무기 판매를 그들이 핵심 주권 문제라고 간주하는 것에 대한 직접적인 도전으로 취급해 왔으며, 과거의 판매는 외교적 항의, 대만 해협 근처에서의 군사적 태세 과시, 양자 간 소통의 일시적 중단을 반복적으로 유발했다.

segments.src: Washington, for its part, has maintained that support for Taiwan's self-defense capabilities is consistent with longstanding U.S.
segments.tr: 워싱턴은 대만의 자위 능력에 대한 지원이 미국의 오랜

segments.src: policy and is not intended as a provocation timed to the visit.
segments.tr: 정책과 일치하며 방문 시기에 맞춘 도발 의도는 없다는 입장을 유지해 왔다.

segments.src: Still, the overlap between the summit and any pending Taiwan-related announcements creates a narrow window in which a single decision in Washington could ripple through the entire diplomatic agenda in ways neither side fully controls.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 정상회담과 대만 관련 발표가 겹치는 것은 워싱턴의 단일 결정이 양측 모두 완전히 통제할 수 없는 방식으로 전체 외교 의제에 파장을 일으킬 수 있는 좁은 창을 만든다.

segments.src: ## What Success — or Failure — Could Look Like
segments.tr: ## 성공 또는 실패의 모습

segments.src: For the Trump administration, a smooth visit offers a chance to project stability on the world stage and demonstrate that engagement with Beijing can coexist with a tougher trade posture.
segments.tr: 트럼프 행정부에게 원만한 방문은 세계 무대에서 안정성을 투영하고 베이징과의 관여가 더 강경한 무역 태세와 공존할 수 있음을 보여줄 기회를 제공한다.

segments.src: For Xi, appearing in Washington after such a long absence carries its own domestic and international signaling value, presenting China as a confident, indispensable partner in global commerce rather than an isolated rival.
segments.tr: 시 주석에게는 오랜 공백 끝에 워싱턴에 나타나는 것 자체가 국내외적으로 중국을 고립된 경쟁자가 아닌 글로벌 상거래에서 자신감 있고 없어서는 안 될 파트너로 제시하는 신호 가치를 지닌다.

segments.src: Both governments have incentives to avoid a public rupture.
segments.tr: 양국 정부 모두 공개적인 결렬을 피해야 할 동기가 있다.

segments.src: A collapsed or acrimonious summit would rattle markets already sensitive to trade policy headlines and could undercut months of lower-profile diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: 정상회담이 결렬되거나 험악하게 끝난다면 무역 정책 헤드라인에 민감한 시장을 뒤흔들고 수개월간의 저자세 외교적 기반 작업을 약화시킬 수 있다.

segments.src: At the same time, neither side appears willing to make major concessions on the issues that matter most to it — Taiwan for Beijing, and technology and trade imbalances for Washington.
segments.tr: 동시에 양측 모두 베이징에게는 대만, 워싱턴에게는 기술 및 무역 불균형과 같이 가장 중요한 문제에 대해 주요 양보를 할 의사가 없어 보인다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Coming Days
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 며칠간 지켜봐야 할 것

segments.src: As the September 24 date approaches, attention will likely center on a few key signals: whether any Taiwan arms package is formally announced before or during the visit, what specific economic commitments emerge from meetings between the business delegation and American counterparts, and whether the two leaders issue any joint statement addressing the broader trajectory of the relationship.
segments.tr: 9월 24일 날짜가 다가옴에 따라 관심은 몇 가지 핵심 신호에 집중될 것이다. 방문 전후로 대만 무기 패키지가 공식 발표되는지, 비즈니스 대표단과 미국 측 상대방 간의 회의에서 어떤 구체적인 경제적 약속이 나오는지, 그리고 양국 정상이 관계의 더 넓은 궤적을 다루는 공동 성명을 발표하는지 여부이다.

segments.src: Given the fragility of U.S.-China ties in recent years, even a summit that produces modest, incremental outcomes — rather than a dramatic breakthrough — would likely be viewed by observers as a meaningful step toward reducing the risk of miscalculation between the two powers.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년간 미중 관계의 취약성을 고려할 때, 극적인 돌파구보다는 완만하고 점진적인 성과를 내는 정상회담이라도 관찰자들은 양국 간의 오판 위험을 줄이는 의미 있는 단계로 볼 가능성이 높다.

segments.src: Whether this visit becomes a turning point or simply a pause before the next flashpoint may not be clear until well after the delegations have gone home.
segments.tr: 이번 방문이 전환점이 될지, 아니면 다음 갈등의 불씨가 터지기 전의 일시적인 휴지기가 될지는 대표단이 귀국한 이후에야 분명해질 것이다.

segments.tr: ## 罕见的华盛顿之行

segments.src: The trip, long anticipated by diplomats and trade analysts on both sides of the Pacific, comes at a moment when the world's two largest economies are trying to steady a relationship that has swung between cautious cooperation and open confrontation over tariffs, technology restrictions, and regional security.
segments.tr: 这次访问长期以来受到太平洋两岸外交官和贸易分析人士的期待。当前，这两个全球最大的经济体正试图稳定彼此的关系，这种关系此前一直在谨慎合作与因关税、技术限制和地区安全而引发的公开对抗之间摇摆。

segments.src: For a leader who has traveled extensively across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe during his time in office, the gap in visits to the U.S.

segments.tr: 首都的间歇期之长是显而易见的。

segments.src: The last time Xi set foot in the White House was under a previous American administration, long before the trade wars, export controls, and pandemic-era disruptions reshaped the contours of the U.S.-China relationship.
segments.tr: 习近平上一次踏入白宫还是在美国前一届政府执政期间，那远在贸易战、出口管制以及大流行时期的干扰重塑美中关系格局之前。

segments.src: That history alone has turned this single visit into a closely watched barometer of where the two powers stand today.
segments.tr: 单是这段历史，就让这一次的访问成为了外界密切关注这两个大国如今关系现状的风向标。

segments.src: ## A Delegation Built for Business
segments.tr: ## 为商业打造的代表团

segments.src: Xi is expected to be accompanied by a large delegation that reportedly includes senior officials alongside executives from major Chinese corporations spanning manufacturing, technology, and energy sectors.
segments.tr: 预计习近平将由一个庞大的代表团陪同，据报道，该代表团成员包括高级官员以及来自制造业、科技和能源等领域的中国大型企业高管。

segments.src: The scale of the business contingent suggests Beijing wants the visit to be remembered not just for diplomatic photo opportunities, but for tangible commercial outcomes — potential agreements on trade volumes, investment commitments, or easing of restrictions that have squeezed companies on both sides.
segments.tr: 这一商业随行人员的规模表明，北京希望这次访问不仅能留下外交合影的机会，还能取得切实可行的商业成果——即在贸易额、投资承诺或放宽对两岸企业造成挤压的限制方面达成潜在协议。

segments.tr: 关注峰会筹备情况的分析人士表示，如此多企业领袖的出席表明，经济稳定而非任何单一的突破，可能是更务实的目标。

segments.src: Years of tariff escalation, supply-chain rerouting, and tit-for-tat export controls on items like semiconductors and rare earth materials have left businesses on both sides eager for predictability, even if a full resolution of underlying disputes remains distant.
segments.tr: 多年的关税升级、供应链重组，以及针对半导体和稀土材料等产品的针锋相对的出口管制，让两岸的企业都渴望获得可预测性，即便彻底解决底层争议依然遥不可及。

segments.tr: 尽管筹备工作正在推进，但这次访问仍笼罩在美中关系中一个熟悉的敏感问题阴影之下：对台军售。

segments.src: Chinese officials have long treated U.S.

segments.src: arms sales to the self-governed island as a direct challenge to what they consider a core sovereignty issue, and past sales have reliably triggered diplomatic protests, military posturing near the Taiwan Strait, and temporary freezes in bilateral communication.
segments.tr: 向该自治岛屿出售武器的行为，视为对其核心主权问题的直接挑战，而过去的军售也确实引发了外交抗议、台湾海峡附近的军事姿态以及双边沟通的暂时冻结。

segments.src: ## What Success — or Failure — Could Look Like
segments.tr: ## 成功或失败可能呈现的样貌

segments.src: For the Trump administration, a smooth visit offers a chance to project stability on the world stage and demonstrate that engagement with Beijing can coexist with a tougher trade posture.
segments.tr: 对于特朗普政府而言，一次顺利的访问提供了在世界舞台上展现稳定性的机会，并证明与北京的接触可以与更强硬的贸易姿态并存。

segments.src: For Xi, appearing in Washington after such a long absence carries its own domestic and international signaling value, presenting China as a confident, indispensable partner in global commerce rather than an isolated rival.
segments.tr: 对于习近平来说，在如此长期的缺席后现身华盛顿，本身就带有其国内和国际的信号价值，将中国塑造为全球商业中自信且不可或缺的合作伙伴，而非孤立的对手。

segments.src: Both governments have incentives to avoid a public rupture.
segments.tr: 两国政府都有动机去避免公开破裂。

segments.src: A collapsed or acrimonious summit would rattle markets already sensitive to trade policy headlines and could undercut months of lower-profile diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: 一次失败或充满火药味的峰会将使对贸易政策新闻本就敏感的市场产生动荡，并可能削弱数月来低调进行的外交铺垫工作。

segments.src: At the same time, neither side appears willing to make major concessions on the issues that matter most to it — Taiwan for Beijing, and technology and trade imbalances for Washington.
segments.tr: 与此同时，双方似乎都不愿意在对其最重要的问题上做出重大妥协——对北京而言是台湾问题，对华盛顿而言则是技术和贸易失衡问题。

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Coming Days
segments.tr: ## 未来几天值得关注的焦点

segments.src: As the September 24 date approaches, attention will likely center on a few key signals: whether any Taiwan arms package is formally announced before or during the visit, what specific economic commitments emerge from meetings between the business delegation and American counterparts, and whether the two leaders issue any joint statement addressing the broader trajectory of the relationship.
segments.tr: 随着9月24日的临近，注意力可能会集中在几个关键信号上：是否在访问前或访问期间正式宣布任何对台军售计划、商业代表团与美国同行会面将达成哪些具体的经济承诺，以及两国领导人是否会发表阐明两国关系更广泛走向的联合声明。

segments.src: Given the fragility of U.S.-China ties in recent years, even a summit that produces modest, incremental outcomes — rather than a dramatic breakthrough — would likely be viewed by observers as a meaningful step toward reducing the risk of miscalculation between the two powers.
segments.tr: 鉴于近年来美中关系的脆弱性，即使是一次只产生温和、渐进式成果——而非戏剧性突破——的峰会，也可能会被观察家视为减少两国间误判风险的有意义的一步。

segments.src: Whether this visit becomes a turning point or simply a pause before the next flashpoint may not be clear until well after the delegations have gone home.
segments.tr: 这次访问是会成为一个转折点，还是仅仅是下一个爆发点前的短暂喘息，可能要等到代表团回国很久之后才会明朗。

segments.src: ## A Rare Trip to Washington
segments.tr: ## वाशिंगटन की एक दुर्लभ यात्रा

segments.tr: चीन के राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग 24 सितंबर को व्हाइट हाउस पहुँचने वाले हैं, जो एक दशक से भी अधिक समय में उनकी वाशिंगटन की पहली यात्रा होगी।

segments.src: The trip, long anticipated by diplomats and trade analysts on both sides of the Pacific, comes at a moment when the world's two largest economies are trying to steady a relationship that has swung between cautious cooperation and open confrontation over tariffs, technology restrictions, and regional security.

segments.tr: राजधानी की यात्राओं में इतना अंतर उल्लेखनीय है।

segments.src: The last time Xi set foot in the White House was under a previous American administration, long before the trade wars, export controls, and pandemic-era disruptions reshaped the contours of the U.S.-China relationship.
segments.tr: अंतिम बार शी ने व्हाइट हाउस में कदम पिछले अमेरिकी प्रशासन के तहत रखा था, व्यापार युद्धों, निर्यात नियंत्रणों और महामारी के दौर के व्यवधानों द्वारा U.S.-चीन संबंधों के स्वरूप को बदलने से काफी पहले।

segments.src: That history alone has turned this single visit into a closely watched barometer of where the two powers stand today.
segments.tr: अकेले उस इतिहास ने इस एक यात्रा को एक बारीकी से देखे जाने वाले बैरोमीटर में बदल दिया है कि आज दोनों महाशक्तियाँ कहाँ खड़ी हैं।

segments.src: ## A Delegation Built for Business
segments.tr: ## व्यापार के लिए बनाया गया एक प्रतिनिधिमंडल

segments.src: Xi is expected to be accompanied by a large delegation that reportedly includes senior officials alongside executives from major Chinese corporations spanning manufacturing, technology, and energy sectors.
segments.tr: शी के साथ एक बड़े प्रतिनिधिमंडल के आने की उम्मीद है, जिसमें कथित तौर पर निर्माण, प्रौद्योगिकी और ऊर्जा क्षेत्रों में फैली प्रमुख चीनी कंपनियों के अधिकारियों के साथ-साथ वरिष्ठ अधिकारी शामिल हैं।

segments.src: The scale of the business contingent suggests Beijing wants the visit to be remembered not just for diplomatic photo opportunities, but for tangible commercial outcomes — potential agreements on trade volumes, investment commitments, or easing of restrictions that have squeezed companies on both sides.
segments.tr: व्यापारिक दल का यह पैमाना बताता है कि बीजिंग चाहता है कि इस यात्रा को न केवल राजनयिक फोटो अवसरों के लिए याद रखा जाए, बल्कि ठोस वाणिज्यिक परिणामों के लिए याद रखा जाए — व्यापार की मात्रा, निवेश प्रतिबद्धताओं, या उन प्रतिबंधों में ढील पर संभावित समझौते जिन्होंने दोनों पक्षों की कंपनियों को प्रभावित किया है।

segments.src: Analysts following the run-up to the summit say the presence of so many corporate leaders signals that economic stabilization, rather than any single breakthrough, is likely to be the practical goal.
segments.tr: शिखर सम्मेलन की तैयारी पर नज़र रखने वाले विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि इतने सारे कॉर्पोरेट नेताओं की मौजूदगी यह संकेत देती है कि किसी एक बड़ी सफलता के बजाय आर्थिक स्थिरता व्यावहारिक लक्ष्य होने की संभावना है।

segments.src: Years of tariff escalation, supply-chain rerouting, and tit-for-tat export controls on items like semiconductors and rare earth materials have left businesses on both sides eager for predictability, even if a full resolution of underlying disputes remains distant.
segments.tr: टैरिफ में वर्षों की वृद्धि, आपूर्ति-श्रृंखला का पुनर्निर्धारण, और सेमीकंडक्टर तथा दुर्लभ पृथ्वी सामग्रियों जैसी वस्तुओं पर एक के बदले दूसरे निर्यात नियंत्रणों ने दोनों पक्षों के व्यवसायों को भविष्यवाणी की इच्छा से भर दिया है, भले ही अंतर्निहित विवादों का पूर्ण समाधान दूर की बात हो।

segments.src: ## Taiwan Arms Sales: The Summit's Fault Line
segments.tr: ## ताइवान हथियार बिक्री: शिखर सम्मेलन का दरार बिंदु

segments.src: Even as preparations move forward, the visit is shadowed by a familiar irritant in U.S.-China relations: arms sales to Taiwan.
segments.tr: तैयारियां आगे बढ़ने के बावजूद, इस यात्रा पर U.S.-चीन संबंधों में एक परिचित अड़चन की छाया है: ताइवान को हथियारों की बिक्री।

segments.src: Beijing has issued pointed warnings that any new American weapons package for Taipei announced around the time of the visit could jeopardize the summit's tone, if not its substance.
segments.tr: बीजिंग ने कड़े शब्दों में चेतावनी दी है कि यात्रा के आसपास ताइपे के लिए घोषित कोई भी नया अमेरिकी हथियार पैकेज शिखर सम्मेलन के मिजाज, यदि उसके सार को नहीं तो, खतरे में डाल सकता है।

segments.src: Chinese officials have long treated U.S.
segments.tr: चीनी अधिकारियों ने लंबे समय से स्व-शासित द्वीप को U.S.

segments.src: arms sales to the self-governed island as a direct challenge to what they consider a core sovereignty issue, and past sales have reliably triggered diplomatic protests, military posturing near the Taiwan Strait, and temporary freezes in bilateral communication.
segments.tr: हथियारों की बिक्री को एक सीधे तौर पर चुनौती माना है जिसे वे एक प्रमुख संप्रभुता का मुद्दा मानते हैं, और अतीत की बिक्री ने नियमित रूप से राजनयिक विरोध, ताइवान जलडमरूमध्य के पास सैन्य हलचल और द्विपक्षीय संचार में अस्थायी रोक को जन्म दिया है।

segments.src: Washington, for its part, has maintained that support for Taiwan's self-defense capabilities is consistent with longstanding U.S.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन ने, अपनी ओर से, यह बनाए रखा है कि ताइवान की आत्म-रक्षा क्षमताओं के लिए समर्थन दीर्घकालिक U.S.

segments.src: policy and is not intended as a provocation timed to the visit.
segments.tr: नीति के अनुरूप है और इसका उद्देश्य यात्रा के समय उकसाना नहीं है।

segments.src: Still, the overlap between the summit and any pending Taiwan-related announcements creates a narrow window in which a single decision in Washington could ripple through the entire diplomatic agenda in ways neither side fully controls.
segments.tr: फिर भी, शिखर सम्मेलन और ताइवान से जुड़ी किसी भी लंबित घोषणा के बीच का ओवरलैप एक संकीर्ण खिड़की बनाता है जिसमें वाशिंगटन में एक एकल निर्णय पूरे राजनयिक एजेंडे में ऐसे तरीकों से लहर पैदा कर सकता है जिन पर किसी भी पक्ष का पूरी तरह से नियंत्रण नहीं है।

segments.src: ## What Success — or Failure — Could Look Like
segments.tr: ## सफलता — या विफलता — कैसी दिख सकती है

segments.src: For the Trump administration, a smooth visit offers a chance to project stability on the world stage and demonstrate that engagement with Beijing can coexist with a tougher trade posture.
segments.tr: ट्रम्प प्रशासन के लिए, एक सुचारू यात्रा विश्व मंच पर स्थिरता की छवि पेश करने का अवसर प्रदान करती है और यह दर्शाती है कि बीजिंग के साथ जुड़ाव सख्त व्यापारिक रुख के साथ सह-अस्तित्व में रह सकता है।

segments.src: For Xi, appearing in Washington after such a long absence carries its own domestic and international signaling value, presenting China as a confident, indispensable partner in global commerce rather than an isolated rival.
segments.tr: शी के लिए, इतने लंबे अंतराल के बाद वाशिंगटन में उपस्थित होने का अपना घरेलू और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संकेत मूल्य है, जो चीन को एक अलग-थलग प्रतिद्वंद्वी के बजाय वैश्विक वाणिज्य में एक आश्वस्त, अपरिहार्य भागीदार के रूप में प्रस्तुत करता है।

segments.src: Both governments have incentives to avoid a public rupture.
segments.tr: दोनों सरकारों के पास सार्वजनिक टूट-फूट से बचने के प्रोत्साहन हैं।

segments.src: A collapsed or acrimonious summit would rattle markets already sensitive to trade policy headlines and could undercut months of lower-profile diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: एक विफल या कटुतापूर्ण शिखर सम्मेलन व्यापार नीति की सुर्खियों के प्रति पहले से ही संवेदनशील बाजारों को हिलाकर रख देगा और महीनों की कम-प्रोफ़ाइल वाली राजनयिक नींव को कमजोर कर सकता है।

segments.src: At the same time, neither side appears willing to make major concessions on the issues that matter most to it — Taiwan for Beijing, and technology and trade imbalances for Washington.
segments.tr: साथ ही, ऐसा नहीं लगता कि कोई भी पक्ष उन मुद्दों पर बड़ी रियायतें देने के लिए तैयार है जो उसके लिए सबसे ज्यादा मायने रखते हैं — बीजिंग के लिए ताइवान, और वाशिंगटन के लिए प्रौद्योगिकी तथा व्यापार असंतुलन।

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Coming Days
segments.tr: ## आने वाले दिनों में क्या देखना है

segments.src: As the September 24 date approaches, attention will likely center on a few key signals: whether any Taiwan arms package is formally announced before or during the visit, what specific economic commitments emerge from meetings between the business delegation and American counterparts, and whether the two leaders issue any joint statement addressing the broader trajectory of the relationship.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे 24 सितंबर की तारीख नज़दीक आ रही है, ध्यान संभवतः कुछ प्रमुख संकेतों पर केंद्रित होगा: क्या ताइवान हथियार पैकेज औपचारिक रूप से यात्रा से पहले या उसके दौरान घोषित किया जाता है, व्यापार प्रतिनिधिमंडल और अमेरिकी समकक्षों के बीच बैठकों से क्या विशिष्ट आर्थिक प्रतिबद्धताएं उभरती हैं, और क्या दोनों नेता संबंधों के व्यापक प्रक्षेपवक्र को संबोधित करते हुए कोई संयुक्त बयान जारी करते हैं।

segments.src: Given the fragility of U.S.-China ties in recent years, even a summit that produces modest, incremental outcomes — rather than a dramatic breakthrough — would likely be viewed by observers as a meaningful step toward reducing the risk of miscalculation between the two powers.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में U.S.-चीन संबंधों की नाजुकता को देखते हुए, एक ऐसा शिखर सम्मेलन भी जो एक नाटकीय सफलता के बजाय मामूली, वृद्धिशील परिणाम देता है — पर्यवेक्षकों द्वारा दोनों महाशक्तियों के बीच गलतफहमी के जोखिम को कम करने की दिशा में एक सार्थक कदम के रूप में देखा जाएगा।

segments.src: Whether this visit becomes a turning point or simply a pause before the next flashpoint may not be clear until well after the delegations have gone home.
segments.tr: क्या यह यात्रा एक मोड़ बनती है या अगले फ्लैशपॉइंट से पहले केवल एक ठहराव बनती है, यह प्रतिनिधिमंडलों के घर लौटने के काफी समय बाद तक स्पष्ट नहीं हो सकता है।

segments.src: The trip, long anticipated by diplomats and trade analysts on both sides of the Pacific, comes at a moment when the world's two largest economies are trying to steady a relationship that has swung between cautious cooperation and open confrontation over tariffs, technology restrictions, and regional security.
segments.tr: A viagem, há muito aguardada por diplomatas e analistas comerciais de ambos os lados do Pacífico, ocorre em um momento em que as duas maiores economias do mundo tentam estabilizar um relacionamento que oscilou entre a cooperação cautelosa e o confronto aberto sobre tarifas, restrições tecnológicas e segurança regional.

segments.src: ## A Delegation Built for Business
segments.tr: ## Uma delegação feita para os negócios

segments.src: Xi is expected to be accompanied by a large delegation that reportedly includes senior officials alongside executives from major Chinese corporations spanning manufacturing, technology, and energy sectors.
segments.tr: Espera-se que Xi seja acompanhado por uma grande delegação que, segundo relatos, inclui altos funcionários ao lado de executivos de grandes corporações chinesas que abrangem os setores de manufatura, tecnologia e energia.

segments.src: The scale of the business contingent suggests Beijing wants the visit to be remembered not just for diplomatic photo opportunities, but for tangible commercial outcomes — potential agreements on trade volumes, investment commitments, or easing of restrictions that have squeezed companies on both sides.
segments.tr: A escala do contingente empresarial sugere que Pequim quer que a visita seja lembrada não apenas por oportunidades de fotos diplomáticas, mas por resultados comerciais tangíveis — possíveis acordos sobre volumes comerciais, compromissos de investimento ou flexibilização de restrições que pressionaram empresas de ambos os lados.

segments.src: Analysts following the run-up to the summit say the presence of so many corporate leaders signals that economic stabilization, rather than any single breakthrough, is likely to be the practical goal.
segments.tr: Analistas que acompanham a preparação para a cúpula dizem que a presença de tantos líderes corporativos sinaliza que a estabilização econômica, em vez de qualquer avanço único, provavelmente será o objetivo prático.

segments.src: Years of tariff escalation, supply-chain rerouting, and tit-for-tat export controls on items like semiconductors and rare earth materials have left businesses on both sides eager for predictability, even if a full resolution of underlying disputes remains distant.
segments.tr: Anos de escalada tarifária, redirecionamento da cadeia de suprimentos e controles de exportação de retaliação em itens como semicondutores e materiais de terras raras deixaram as empresas de ambos os lados ansiosas por previsibilidade, mesmo que uma resolução completa das disputas subjacentes permaneça distante.

segments.src: ## What Success — or Failure — Could Look Like
segments.tr: ## Como seria o sucesso — ou o fracasso

segments.src: For the Trump administration, a smooth visit offers a chance to project stability on the world stage and demonstrate that engagement with Beijing can coexist with a tougher trade posture.
segments.tr: Para a administração Trump, uma visita tranquila oferece a chance de projetar estabilidade no cenário mundial e demonstrar que o engajamento com Pequim pode coexistir com uma postura comercial mais rígida.

segments.src: For Xi, appearing in Washington after such a long absence carries its own domestic and international signaling value, presenting China as a confident, indispensable partner in global commerce rather than an isolated rival.

segments.src: Both governments have incentives to avoid a public rupture.

segments.src: A collapsed or acrimonious summit would rattle markets already sensitive to trade policy headlines and could undercut months of lower-profile diplomatic groundwork.

segments.src: At the same time, neither side appears willing to make major concessions on the issues that matter most to it — Taiwan for Beijing, and technology and trade imbalances for Washington.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Coming Days

segments.src: Given the fragility of U.S.-China ties in recent years, even a summit that produces modest, incremental outcomes — rather than a dramatic breakthrough — would likely be viewed by observers as a meaningful step toward reducing the risk of miscalculation between the two powers.
segments.tr: Dada a fragilidade dos laços EUA-China nos últimos anos, mesmo uma cúpula que produza resultados modestos e incrementais — em vez de um avanço dramático — provavelmente seria vista pelos observadores como um passo significativo para reduzir o risco de erro de cálculo entre as duas potências.

segments.src: ## A Rare Trip to Washington

segments.src: Chinese President Xi Jinping is scheduled to arrive at the White House on September 24, marking his first visit to Washington in more than a decade.
segments.tr: Der chinesische Staatspräsident Xi Jinping wird voraussichtlich am 24. September im Weißen Haus eintreffen. Dies ist sein erster Besuch in Washington seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt.

segments.src: The trip, long anticipated by diplomats and trade analysts on both sides of the Pacific, comes at a moment when the world's two largest economies are trying to steady a relationship that has swung between cautious cooperation and open confrontation over tariffs, technology restrictions, and regional security.
segments.tr: Die Reise, die von Diplomaten und Handelsanalysten auf beiden Seiten des Pazifiks lange erwartet wurde, findet zu einem Zeitpunkt statt, an dem die beiden größten Volkswirtschaften der Welt versuchen, eine Beziehung zu stabilisieren, die zwischen vorsichtiger Kooperation und offener Konfrontation in Bezug auf Zölle, Technologiebeschränkungen und regionale Sicherheit geschwankt hat.

segments.src: For a leader who has traveled extensively across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe during his time in office, the gap in visits to the U.S.
segments.tr: Für einen Staatschef, der während seiner Amtszeit ausgiebig durch Asien, den Nahen Osten und Europa gereist ist, ist die Pause bei Besuchen in der US-

segments.src: capital is notable.
segments.tr: Hauptstadt bemerkenswert.

segments.src: The last time Xi set foot in the White House was under a previous American administration, long before the trade wars, export controls, and pandemic-era disruptions reshaped the contours of the U.S.-China relationship.
segments.tr: Das letzte Mal, als Xi einen Fuß ins Weiße Haus setzte, war unter einer vorherigen US-Regierung, lange bevor Handelskonflikte, Ausfuhrkontrollen und pandemiebedingte Störungen die Konturen der Beziehungen zwischen den USA und China neu geformt hatten.

segments.src: That history alone has turned this single visit into a closely watched barometer of where the two powers stand today.
segments.tr: Allein diese Geschichte hat diesen einzigen Besuch zu einem genau beobachteten Barometer dafür gemacht, wo die beiden Großmächte heute stehen.

segments.src: ## A Delegation Built for Business
segments.tr: ## Eine für Geschäfte aufgestellte Delegation

segments.src: Xi is expected to be accompanied by a large delegation that reportedly includes senior officials alongside executives from major Chinese corporations spanning manufacturing, technology, and energy sectors.
segments.tr: Es wird erwartet, dass Xi von einer großen Delegation begleitet wird, die Berichten zufolge neben hochrangigen Beamten auch Führungskräfte wichtiger chinesischer Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Fertigung, Technologie und Energie umfasst.

segments.src: The scale of the business contingent suggests Beijing wants the visit to be remembered not just for diplomatic photo opportunities, but for tangible commercial outcomes — potential agreements on trade volumes, investment commitments, or easing of restrictions that have squeezed companies on both sides.
segments.tr: Das Ausmaß des Wirtschaftskontingents lässt darauf schließen, dass Peking möchte, dass der Besuch nicht nur wegen diplomatischer Fotomöglichkeiten in Erinnerung bleibt, sondern wegen greifbarer wirtschaftlicher Ergebnisse – potenzieller Vereinbarungen über Handelsvolumina, Investitionszusagen oder der Lockerung von Beschränkungen, die Unternehmen auf beiden Seiten unter Druck gesetzt haben.

segments.src: Analysts following the run-up to the summit say the presence of so many corporate leaders signals that economic stabilization, rather than any single breakthrough, is likely to be the practical goal.
segments.tr: Analysten, die die Vorbereitungen für den Gipfel verfolgen, sagen, dass die Anwesenheit so vieler Unternehmenslenker darauf hindeutet, dass wirtschaftliche Stabilisierung statt eines einzelnen Durchbruchs das praktische Ziel sein dürfte.

segments.src: Years of tariff escalation, supply-chain rerouting, and tit-for-tat export controls on items like semiconductors and rare earth materials have left businesses on both sides eager for predictability, even if a full resolution of underlying disputes remains distant.
segments.tr: Jahrelange Zolleskalationen, Umleitungen von Lieferketten und gegenseitige Ausfuhrkontrollen bei Artikeln wie Halbleitern und Seltenen Erden haben Unternehmen auf beiden Seiten nach Vorhersehbarkeit sehnen lassen, selbst wenn eine vollständige Lösung der zugrunde liegenden Streitigkeiten noch in weiter Ferne liegt.

segments.tr: ## Thành công — hoặc thất bại — có thể trông như thế nào

segments.src: For the Trump administration, a smooth visit offers a chance to project stability on the world stage and demonstrate that engagement with Beijing can coexist with a tougher trade posture.
segments.tr: Đối với chính quyền Trump, một chuyến thăm suôn sẻ mang lại cơ hội thể hiện sự ổn định trên trường quốc tế và chứng minh rằng việc can dự với Bắc Kinh có thể cùng tồn tại với lập trường thương mại cứng rắn hơn.

segments.src: For Xi, appearing in Washington after such a long absence carries its own domestic and international signaling value, presenting China as a confident, indispensable partner in global commerce rather than an isolated rival.
segments.tr: Đối với ông Tập, việc xuất hiện tại Washington sau một thời gian dài vắng bóng mang lại giá trị tín hiệu đối nội và đối ngoại riêng, thể hiện Trung Quốc là một đối tác tự tin, không thể thiếu trong thương mại toàn cầu thay vì một đối thủ bị cô lập.

segments.src: Both governments have incentives to avoid a public rupture.
segments.tr: Cả hai chính phủ đều có động lực để tránh một sự rạn nứt công khai.

segments.src: A collapsed or acrimonious summit would rattle markets already sensitive to trade policy headlines and could undercut months of lower-profile diplomatic groundwork.
segments.tr: Một hội nghị thượng đỉnh đổ vỡ hoặc gay gắt sẽ làm rung chuyển các thị trường vốn đã nhạy cảm với các tiêu đề chính sách thương mại và có thể làm suy yếu nhiều tháng chuẩn bị ngoại giao kín tiếng.

segments.src: At the same time, neither side appears willing to make major concessions on the issues that matter most to it — Taiwan for Beijing, and technology and trade imbalances for Washington.
segments.tr: Đồng thời, không bên nào tỏ ra sẵn sàng nhượng bộ lớn về các vấn đề quan trọng nhất đối với mình — Đài Loan đối với Bắc Kinh, và mất cân bằng công nghệ và thương mại đối với Washington.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Coming Days
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần theo dõi trong những ngày tới

segments.src: As the September 24 date approaches, attention will likely center on a few key signals: whether any Taiwan arms package is formally announced before or during the visit, what specific economic commitments emerge from meetings between the business delegation and American counterparts, and whether the two leaders issue any joint statement addressing the broader trajectory of the relationship.
segments.tr: Khi ngày 24 tháng 9 đến gần, sự chú ý có thể sẽ tập trung vào một vài tín hiệu chính: liệu bất kỳ gói vũ khí nào cho Đài Loan có được công bố chính thức trước hoặc trong chuyến thăm hay không, những cam kết kinh tế cụ thể nào xuất hiện từ các cuộc họp giữa phái đoàn doanh nghiệp và các đối tác Mỹ, và liệu hai nhà lãnh đạo có đưa ra bất kỳ tuyên bố chung nào giải quyết quỹ đạo rộng lớn hơn của mối quan hệ hay không.

segments.src: Given the fragility of U.S.-China ties in recent years, even a summit that produces modest, incremental outcomes — rather than a dramatic breakthrough — would likely be viewed by observers as a meaningful step toward reducing the risk of miscalculation between the two powers.
segments.tr: Với sự mong manh của quan hệ Mỹ-Trung trong những năm gần đây, ngay cả một hội nghị thượng đỉnh mang lại những kết quả khiêm tốn, tăng dần — thay vì một bước đột phá đáng kể — có thể sẽ được các nhà quan sát coi là một bước tiến có ý nghĩa nhằm giảm nguy cơ tính toán sai lầm giữa hai cường quốc.

segments.src: Whether this visit becomes a turning point or simply a pause before the next flashpoint may not be clear until well after the delegations have gone home.
segments.tr: Liệu chuyến thăm này trở thành một bước ngoặt hay chỉ đơn giản là một khoảng dừng trước điểm nóng tiếp theo có thể sẽ không rõ ràng cho đến rất lâu sau khi các phái đoàn đã về nước.
